name: TinyZKP Limits and Capabilities
summary: Canonical buyer-facing limits, plan quotas, anonymous playground constraints, supported receipt boundaries, and escalation triggers for TinyZKP.

product_boundary.verification: Free public verification through the browser verifier, hosted API, SDKs, CLI, or MCP where compatible.

notes: Use an API key for production plan limits, account-level spend controls, and supportable workflows.

self_serve_plans.name: Free
self_serve_plans.best_for: Evaluation, demos, and first agent integrations.

self_serve_plans.name: Developer
self_serve_plans.best_for: Production pilots where receipts are attached to one workflow.

self_serve_plans.name: Pro
self_serve_plans.best_for: Teams adding receipts to customer-visible automations.

self_serve_plans.name: Scale
self_serve_plans.best_for: Production services with many receipts and support needs.

self_serve_plans.name: Compute
self_serve_plans.best_for: Large supported state-transition traces, backfills, and audit packages priced by trace step.

best_for: Workloads where high-RAM prover infrastructure is the economic alternative
review_when: Peak concurrency or queue priority needs a commitment
Trace size is unusual or latency-sensitive

capability_matrix.escalation: Use pilot planning for expanded workflow rollout.

capability_matrix.limit_or_boundary: Verification is free; local WASM support depends on proof format compatibility, with hosted fallback for current production receipts.
capability_matrix.escalation: Use design review when verification must run on-chain or inside a restricted runtime.

capability_matrix.limit_or_boundary: Anonymous capabilities are limited; authenticated MCP calls map to the same account limits as the HTTP API.
capability_matrix.escalation: Use a paid plan or enterprise review for production agent workloads.

capability_matrix.limit_or_boundary: Developer, Pro, and Scale include monthly spend caps; Compute is usage-based by trace step.
capability_matrix.escalation: Use enterprise review for reserved capacity, invoice billing, or custom usage commitments.

capability_matrix.limit_or_boundary: Security status, status page, OpenAPI, schemas, and release policy are public.
capability_matrix.escalation: Use procurement review for contractual terms, retention requirements, or support targets.

unsupported_without_review: On-chain verifier support for every chain
Custom state machines not represented by accumulator_step
Sub-second proving on every UI interaction
Contractual support targets before commercial terms are agreed
escalation_triggers: The verifier must check a statement other than the live additive accumulator transition.
Private inputs, masking, or customer secrets are involved.
Expected monthly spend or concurrency needs a custom cap or reserved workers.
The receipt is customer-, auditor-, counterparty-, or regulator-visible and procurement needs a security packet.
The workflow requires on-chain, air-gapped, or restricted-runtime verification.
Trace size, latency, or backfill volume makes Compute planning necessary.
